# ShaadiTemplate

> Free online maker for Indian wedding invitation cards. Pick a design for Save the Date, Ring Ceremony, Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, the wedding, the reception or a baby shower (simant), fill in the families' names in English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi or Tamil (phonetic typing, no Indian keyboard needed), and download a 1080x1920 image for WhatsApp or a 5x7 inch print-ready PDF. No login; drafts stay in the visitor's browser. Couples can also publish a free wedding website with RSVP. Made in Surat, India.

## Designs

- [Designs by ceremony and language](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/): every design with a preview, and a link to each design's own page (all pages of the card, its sample wording, ceremony, language and God or sacred symbol)
- By ceremony: [Save the Date](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/save-the-date-invitations.html), [Ring Ceremony](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/engagement-ring-ceremony-invitations.html), [Haldi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/haldi-invitations.html), [Mehendi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/mehendi-invitations.html), [Sangeet](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/sangeet-invitations.html), [Reception](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/reception-invitations.html), [Baby shower (simant)](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/baby-shower-invitations.html)
- [Wedding invitation cards](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/wedding-invitations.html): kankotri, shaadi card, lagna patrika, Anand Karaj, Christian and more
- [Gujarati invitations](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/gujarati-invitations.html), [Hindi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/hindi-invitations.html), [Marathi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/marathi-invitations.html), [Punjabi](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/punjabi-invitations.html), [Tamil](https://shaaditemplate.com/templates/tamil-invitations.html)

## Wedding websites

- [Wedding website designs](https://shaaditemplate.com/websites/): free wedding websites with the couple's story, every function, venue map, RSVP and guest blessings on one link; designs for Hindu, Gujarati, Sikh Anand Karaj, Tamil, Christian, Nikah and garden weddings, each with a live sample
